items.title: Len Manno Interview, 1959-02-06
items.q: Skipper Trevathan played piano with him

ctx.x: I have heard Len Harrell try to play like him do you know Len Harrell never heard of him he used to be piano player with a Jimmy Joy he was a big peck Kelly admiral but now he's a executive some date company sells dates

well the closest that we had to pet Kelly down there was a boy by the name of Eddie Oliver now there there are a whole bunch of Eddie Oliver's there was an Eddie Oliver that was with the old Ben Bernie band and there was another Eddie Oliver over in Beaumont somewhere but this one was from Houston incidentally he's in Chicago now but he played very much like peck he was influenced by peck but while he did play very much like peck there was only one Kelly no and and and and like and like all of these fellas you…
